building_mask.mask_policy: All raster cells touched by an actual current building footprint are excluded from generalized canopy rendering. Original positive observations remain unchanged in the source raster. Masked cells are not declared non-woody.

geometry_policy: Positive observed woody-cover cells only; four-connected components, preserved holes, exact reviewed extent clip, no dilation/random fill/individual tree positions or measured heights.
rendering_policy: Continuous generalized canopy volumes may use disclosed cartographic vertical dimensions. They are not surveyed tree models. Source2021-2022 changes and classification uncertainty remain unresolved; NoData is unknown.
